yt.desc: Pull a YouTube transcript and summarise it
yt.template: Fetch the transcript of {url} with yt_transcript, then give me a tight summary of its key points, with any concrete claims called out.

research.desc: Web search a topic and digest the best sources
research.template: Search the web for {topic}, pick the two most substantial results, fetch each with fetch_url, and give me a synthesis with the source URLs.

findcode.desc: Find files by glob and describe them
findcode.template: Use find_files to locate files matching {pattern} under {root}, then report the count and a one-line guess at each file's purpose from its name.

openlog.desc: Open a file on my desktop
openlog.template: Open {path} in my editor with open_editor and confirm what you opened.
